newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP to ship more Yandi iron ore.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP to ship more Yandi iron ore.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday it had agreed with Japanese steel mills to ship 8.5 million tonnes of Yandi iron ore in the year to May 31, 1998, up from 8.0 million tonnes expected in the current 1996/97 year.
It said it had also agreed to a 1.1 percent increase in the price of the Yandi ore to 27.35 U.S. cents per dry long ton unit, in line with the earlier announced Mt Newman ore agreement.

BHP said it had agreed to a 1.1 percent price increase to 29.10 U.S. cents per dry long ton unit for its Goldsworthy fines, but that Goldsworthy tonnages would remain about the same in 1997/98 as the 3.16 million tonnes expected in 1996/97.
The price of Goldsworthy lump iron ore was unchanged at 37.68 U.S. cents per dry long ton unit.
BHP Iron Ore Group General Manager Geoff Wedlock said the negotiations had been cordial and co-operative, strengthening the relationships between the Japanese Steel Mills and the company.
